tool_schemas.name: initialize_asr_got_graph
tool_schemas.description: Initializes a new ASR-GoT analysis session by creating the root node n₀ labeled "Task Understanding" and populating the full P1.12 metadata schema from the provided task description, confidence vector, and optional configuration. Returns the created graph/session identifiers plus the root node and stored metadata defaults as applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when task_description is missing/empty or initial_confidence is not a 4-item vector of numbers in [0,1], UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when session creation limits are reached.

task_description.description: Detailed description of the research task or question - stored verbatim in metadata per P1.6

initial_confidence.description: P1.5 multi-dimensional confidence vector [empirical_support, theoretical_basis, methodological_rigor, consensus_alignment]

config.description: Configuration for P1.23 multi-layer networks and other parameters

tool_schemas.name: decompose_research_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or updates) the task decomposition by adding dimension nodes for the requested dimensions, ensuring the mandatory "Potential Biases" and "Knowledge Gaps" dimensions are present, and returns the resulting set of dimension node IDs. This endpoint is not paged; it returns the full dimension list for the session after the operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if no ASR-GoT graph/session exists to decompose, VALIDATION_ERROR if dimensions is not a list of non-empty strings, CONFLICT if decomposition is refused because the graph is in a state that disallows modifying the dimension layer, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the session.

dimensions.description: P1.2 task dimensions (default: Scope, Objectives, Constraints, Data Needs, Use Cases, Potential Biases, Knowledge Gaps)

tool_schemas.name: generate_hypotheses
tool_schemas.description: Adds 3–5 hypotheses to a specific dimension node (e.g., 2.X), storing each hypothesis with P1.5 confidence, required falsification criteria and plan, and optional disciplinary tags/attribution, and returns the created hypothesis node IDs linked to the dimension. This endpoint is not paged; it returns all hypotheses created by the request. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target dimension_node_id does not exist in the session, VALIDATION_ERROR if hypotheses has fewer than 3 or more than 5 items, if required fields (content, plan, falsification_criteria) are missing, or if confidence/impact values are out of range, CONFLICT if hypotheses cannot be added due to an incompatible graph state, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks write access.

dimension_node_id.description: ID of dimension node (format: 2.X) to generate hypotheses for

confidence.description: P1.5 confidence vector [empirical_support, theoretical_basis, methodological_rigor, consensus_alignment]

falsification_criteria.description: P1.16 explicit falsifiability criteria - REQUIRED for hypotheses

tool_schemas.name: get_graph_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns a comprehensive summary of the current ASR-GoT graph including P1.11 formalism state and, optionally, P1.22 topology metrics, P1.23 layer analysis, and overall P1.0–P1.29 parameter status as requested. This endpoint is not paged; it returns a single summary document for the session’s current consistent graph state. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session/graph does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access, and CONFLICT if a summary cannot be produced because the graph is in a transient/inconsistent state.

tool_schemas.name: export_graph_data
tool_schemas.description: Exports the current ASR-GoT graph in the requested format (json or yaml), optionally including the P1.6 reasoning trace appendix, P1.22 topology insights, and full P1.0–P1.29 parameter status, and returns the serialized export payload. This endpoint is not paged; it returns a single complete export for the session snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported format values or invalid option types, NOT_FOUND if the session/graph does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks export access, and CONFLICT if export is refused because the graph snapshot cannot be materialized in the current state.

format.description: Export format with complete P1.11 formalism and P1.6 requirements

tool_schemas.name: execute_resilient_query
tool_schemas.description: Execute a scientific research query with built-in fallback mechanisms that ensure successful completion even if individual stages fail. This is the most reliable way to process queries.

query.description: The research question or task to analyze

tool_schemas.name: list_research_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists ASR-GoT research sessions visible to the caller, optionally filtering by lifecycle status and tags. Returns a paginated list ordered by most recently updated. Refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR and returns UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access.

disciplinary_tag.description: Filter sessions containing the given disciplinary tag.

created_after.description: Only return sessions created after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only return sessions created before this timestamp (inclusive).

page_size.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; obtain from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_research_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single research session by id, including its current lifecycle status and stored configuration fields. Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller; returns FORBIDDEN when access is denied.

id.description: Primary key of the research_sessions row to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_research_session
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a research session and can drive allowed lifecycle transitions via status. Refuses updates to archived sessions with CONFLICT, and refuses illegal status transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR. Returns the updated session record.

id.description: Primary key of the research session to update.

task_description.description: Updated task description; stored verbatim when provided.

initial_confidence.description: Updated P1.5 confidence vector [empirical_support, theoretical_basis, methodological_rigor, consensus_alignment].

enable_multi_layer.description: Enable/disable P1.23 multi-layer network behavior for the session.

enable_fallbacks.description: Enable/disable resilient fallbacks for executions linked to this session.

default_dimensions.description: Default dimension labels to use for decomposition; must include "Potential Biases" and "Knowledge Gaps" when provided.

disciplinary_tags.description: P1.8 disciplinary provenance tags for the session.

attribution.description: P1.29 collaboration attribution for the session.

status.description: Lifecycle status transition target; must follow allowed transitions for the current status.

tool_schemas.name: list_query_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists resilient query executions for a given session (or across sessions when session_id is omitted, if permitted), optionally filtering by execution status. Returns a paginated list with stage-by-stage status snapshots. Refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR and returns FORBIDDEN when access is denied.

session_id.description: If provided, only return executions belonging to this research session.

started_after.description: Only return executions started after this timestamp (inclusive).

started_before.description: Only return executions started before this timestamp (inclusive).

page_size.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; obtain from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_query_execution
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single resilient query execution by id, including its current status, stages, and final outputs (when finished). Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller; returns FORBIDDEN when access is denied.

id.description: Primary key of the query_executions row to fetch.
